title: summary_timeout_seconds is ignored by checkpoint explain --generate

verdict.rationale: The commit added the SummaryTimeoutSeconds field and helper as groundwork, with wiring planned in later tasks (7-13). Nothing in the evidence shows that ignoring the setting in the generate path was chosen; it looks like incomplete wiring.
